remarks: ALL UTILITIES INCLUDED (Gas, Electric, Water) WiFi not included. This 700sf second floor one bedroom, one bath home was fully renovated in 2016. The spacious open living room enjoys south western exposures/views and is adjacent to the new eat-in kitchen with stainless steel appliances and quartz counter tops. The fully renovated bathroom features marble and quartz tile. The bedroom offers generous closet space including a large walk-in as well as room for your home office. A larger outdoor terrace, in-unit washer and dryer and ample off street parking complete this offering.
